notes: The governing document for faculty leave, the Faculty Leaves Policy, is cited by both the Rank and Status Policy (4.5) and the request form but is not saved. The faculty Parental Leave (c1) is known only from the AVP request form (version 10-14): eligibility (full-time CFS and CFS-track faculty), the primary-caregiver purpose, that it is paid, the one-year return commitment, FMLA concurrency and a single leave period (Fall, Winter or Spring/Summer). Its length, pay level and entitlement wording are not in any saved source; the coded 1 semester, discretionary, is a reading of the form and is flagged.
Missing is false: the request form states a parental provision for faculty (the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, does not apply).

The staff paid maternity (6 weeks) and parental (1 week) leave announced in June 2017 (c7-c9) are for full-time benefited staff and administrators only; the news item's FAQ 6 says they do not apply to faculty ('the existing faculty leave policy continues to apply'). Recorded with excludes_main_faculty and summary_only.

Rank and Status Policy version: dated 14 January 2008, still posted unchanged in November 2017 (version note); possible unarchived revisions before the reference date. The form is the 2014 version, linked on the AVP page in 2017.

The request form caps CFS-clock delays at two before CFS ('not to exceed two delays'), while Rank and Status Policy 4.5 allows a one-time, one-year delay without leave and an automatic delay for personal leaves; the form's two delays may combine the two routes. Recorded on c3 (note, ambiguous flag) and c4 (use_limit 1 from the policy, with the form's wording in the note).

Birth parent chain (faculty): Parental Leave, one semester paid (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks running concurrently from its start (c2). Staff only, excluded: medical maternity 6 weeks (c7) -> parental 1 week (c8) -> own sick or vacation balances (c9).

Non-birth parent chain (faculty): Parental Leave, one semester paid, if the primary caregiver (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent (c2). Staff only, excluded: parental 1 week (c8) within three months of the birth -> own balances (c9).

Cross-references found but not saved: Faculty Leaves Policy (relevant: governs faculty parental, personal and FMLA leave); Faculty Discipline and Termination Policy; Faculty Grievance Policy; Procedures for Termination and Academic Freedom Grievances Policy; The Aims of a BYU Education; The Mission of Brigham Young University; Church Educational System Honor Code (none of the last six concern leave).
